precondition: Gate 1 passed 2026-08-03; instrument v2 validated (readable plan, heldout ceiling 1.0).

revision_provenance.what_changed: Only the second Gate-2 condition: 'rises-with-prefix.v1' -> 'retention.v3'. The v1 condition was designed for the inference regime (subgoal gradually inferred from behaviour, so probe accuracy rises with prefix). Under the v4 staged-revelation protocol the label is explicitly announced at step 0 / each arrival, so there is nothing to accumulate; the only failure mode the condition should catch is retention collapse across the suffix. retention.v3 therefore requires the late bucket to clear the same 2x-chance bar and the early-to-late decay to stay bounded.
revision_provenance.forking_paths_mitigation: Because the revision was motivated after observing the v2 run, this v3 adjudication uses a FRESH corpus seed (20260804): a new environment graph and new route splits that no criterion choice was conditioned on. The sealed v1 and v2 artifacts are not re-adjudicated; their verdicts stand as registered. The retention bound (0.15) and all other thresholds are frozen here before any fresh-seed model readout exists.

v2_reference_readouts_for_transparency.note: Recorded so the motivation is auditable; these numbers play no role in the v3 decision.

corpus.note: Fresh seed relative to v1/v2 (20260802). Train-split orderings only; heldout excluded at generation time.

probe.feature: final-prompt-position hidden state per layer (capture_prefix_diagnostics, prefix_pairs=None)
probe.input: cumulative trajectory prefix through step k (past step lines with expert actions, bare step-k observation last)
probe.target: active subgoal = next objective ahead on the route
probe.layer_selection: train-split: fixed layer chosen by validation accuracy on a deterministic case-id fit/val split of the train rows only; ties break to the lower layer

gate2_thresholds.condition_beats_base: pretrained selected-layer accuracy > original-Qwen selected-layer accuracy (causal contrast)
gate2_thresholds.decision: all three must hold to pass

decision_rules: Gate 2 passes only if all three conditions hold; then Stage 3 reruns the rate-distortion criterion on the v3 merged base.

Gate 2 fails otherwise: with the readable-plan instrument (ceiling 1.0) and the regime-matched second condition, a fail now convicts the substrate claim at this scale; the LLM-transfer route is killed and no Stage-3 rerun is run.
The continued-pretrained base is an offline rare-heavy substrate refresh (merged, frozen, fingerprinted); the original Qwen path is untouched.
The pretraining corpus contains only train-split orderings; heldout orderings are excluded at generation time.
Sealed v1 and v2 artifacts are not re-adjudicated by this run.
prohibited_after_execution: changing any of the three Gate-2 conditions, the 2x-chance multiplier, or the 0.15 retention bound
switching the layer-selection rule after seeing heldout accuracies
re-running with a different corpus seed or protocol and reporting only the better outcome
using the ridge/regression probe R^2 in place of the classification accuracy gate
reusing the pretraining corpus routes as probe/Stage-3 evaluation routes
